name: ariana-report-monorepo
description: Frontend-only banded reporting toolkit: JSON templates, JSON data, viewer, designer, PDF and Excel export.

scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @ariana-reports/core build && corepack pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.check: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test
scripts.lint:package: corepack pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" exec publint --pack npm && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" exec attw --pack . --profile node16
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm check && corepack pnpm lint:package && corepack pnpm size

author: Behnam Aghaali
